summary: A 1930 pre-cut L-4 cabin on the ground at Willow Ridge in the Clearwater National Forest; manned from 1929 until a 1934 fire burned it, and never manned again.

facts.design: L-4 cabin on log sills flat on the ground, no tower
facts.status_note: The cabin burned in the 1934 fire.

visit.trail_note: In 1981 Louis Hartig placed the point at the end of Trail #237, reached by way of Fish Creek.

notes_for_editor: Location conflict, not resolved: the record uses the FFLA point 46.39583, -115.40080, and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 46.37878, -115.39767, about 1.9 km apart. The Forest Service list gives Sec 12 T35N R8E, 5 miles NW of Old Lochsa RS, which could settle it by a township check; the record was not changed. The 1934 fire is not named for this lookout in any source; the Pete King Fire burned Old Man Point, a different lookout, so it is not attributed here. Record kind 'ground' is supported by Hartig's 'no understory or tower'. No photo is listed by the Forest Service list. Access level is not stated by any source.
